summary: Master advanced Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) to reduce risk and optimize performance. Join our expert-led 5-day course for global professionals.
lede: Contract lifecycle management coordinates contracts from planning through performance and close-out. This training is for experienced commercial, procurement and legal operations professionals managing high-value relationships, with a practical focus on contract risks and obligations. Learners practise allocating risk, creating negotiation playbooks and obligation matrices, and monitoring service levels and performance indicators to support commercial decisions.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for experienced professionals who manage high-value commercial relationships and complex regulatory environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in contract management, procurement, or legal operations. A working knowledge of basic contract law and experience managing commercial relationships is required. No prior coding or software engineering knowledge is needed, though familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is beneficial.
